in_marathi.name: Manto
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manto हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manto is derived from the Sanskrit word 'manas' meaning mind, and 'tam' meaning protected. It is also associated with mountains and mantles, signifying strength, protection, and wisdom.
